newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, new gains for blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, new gains for blue chips.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed with new gains among blue chips on Tuesday amid renewed investor interest.
* Six of 19 active issues rose, seven fell, five were flat and one traded for the first time.
* Volume rose to 30,580 units and turnover to 21 million kuna from last Friday's 17 million.
* Chocolate maker Kras was top gainer, rising 4.77 percent to 461 kuna on volume of 801 shares.
* Textile firm Varteks, dipping 10.9 percent with 100 shares sold, led decliners.
* Podravka food concern was the most actively traded issue with 3,310 shares, closing one kuna lower at 308 kuna.
* New entry on the parallel bourse list Mednik, an agricultural firm, sold 18,833 units in what looked like two pre-arranged deals. It closed at 714.96 kuna. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
